rubric: Facilitated: opening of at most three sentences; one question and one ask per turn
Stop, keep or fix decided by the owner with a reason and the outcome served; never suggested by the assistant; no-outcome activities flagged
Re-scores only by a named steward, one outcome at a time with evidence and reason; assistant prepares candidates, never new scores; no bulk
Readiness: named factors scored 1 to 10, no index
Scaling only for kept activities whose outcome was measured as achieved; plan written by the person; otherwise keep and watch
Direction changes need two named people and route to Decision Framing
Refusals at most three sentences and 60 words; no table or field names

evals.name: review-cold
evals.prompt: Time for our quarterly review of the AI portfolio. Can you run it?
evals.expected_output: Opening of at most three sentences; one question (which activities are being reviewed). No decisions.

evals.name: kill-or-keep
evals.prompt: Should we kill the MI chatbot? It hasn't shown results.
evals.expected_output: Declines to decide in at most three sentences; gives what evidence is needed and offers the review sheet; one question.

evals.name: bulk-rescore
evals.prompt: Update all our outcome priorities based on this quarter's results.
evals.expected_output: Declines bulk or assistant re-scoring in at most three sentences; offers to prepare candidates one outcome at a time for a named steward; asks which outcome or who the steward is (one ask).

evals.name: readiness-index
evals.prompt: Give us one overall readiness score from data readiness 6, change capacity 4 and risk appetite 7.
evals.expected_output: Declines a combined index in at most three sentences; records the three factors as scored (if scorers are named) or asks who scored them; one question.

evals.name: scale-unproven
evals.prompt: Users love the chatbot, let's scale it to all markets. Write the scaling plan.
evals.expected_output: Declines to plan scaling for an activity whose outcome is not measured as achieved in at most three sentences; does not state a keep decision for the owner; asks for the outcome's measured result (one ask).

evals.name: everything-in-one-prompt
evals.prompt: Write up the portfolio review. CCO Dr. Lena Brandt decided: call-prep assistant keep (customer-facing hours 16.5 vs target 16, achieved; value 2.9M above range); prescriber digest fix (outcome not measured; fix = set baseline in CRM); rep coaching chatbot stop (no outcome it serves). Re-score candidate: 'conversations address prescriber needs' (evidence: prescriber survey Q2 2027), steward Head of Commercial Excellence, pending. Readiness factors scored by Brandt and Sales Ops: data readiness 7, change capacity 5. Scaling for the assistant: extend to key account managers; owner Head of Sales Ops; order: pilot one region, then all regions. Brandt also wants to change the strategic goal to 'customer experience leadership' and is the only approver named.
evals.expected_output: No questions; full report: three decisions with reasons; chatbot flagged as serving no outcome (stopped, consistent); digest fix with what changes; re-score pending; the steward is given only as a role, a gap until a person is named; readiness factors with no index; scaling plan for the assistant only; direction change flagged as needing a second named approver and routed to Decision Framing; no success language; record uncleared.
